svg.title: Abeille — Apis mellifera
svg.desc: A worker European honey bee in a slightly oblique dorsal view, its head turned toward the upper left. Two elbowed antennae rise from a small dark head with lateral compound eyes and three ocelli. Fine ochre-brown hairs cover the rounded thorax; six jointed legs arise from it, the broad hind tibiae bearing pollen baskets. Four transparent, organically veined wings spread from the thorax, the hind pair visibly smaller. Curved umber and subdued honey-coloured abdominal segments taper to a softly hairy point. Fine warm-grey engraving and translucent restrained washes on a transparent field.
